function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:

If you need the precise time, you can check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s world‑clock feature, or a time‑synchronization service (e.g., `time.is/NYC`, `worldtimeapi.org/api/timezone/America/New_York`, or simply look at the “New York” entry in your device’s clock app).
